description: This file defines functions and types for converting Markdown table data into Slack table blocks, including rendering fallback text and handling table constraints.

classes.name: SlackTableBlock
classes.description: Type defining the Slack table block structure with column settings and rows.

methods.name: hasVisibleHeaders
methods.description: Checks if the headers array contains any non-empty header, indicating visible headers.

methods.name: getCappedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows capped at SLACK_MAX_TABLE_ROWS.

methods.name: getMaxColumnCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of columns in the table, limited by SLACK_MAX_TABLE_COLUMNS.

methods.name: truncateFallbackCell
methods.description: Truncates cell text to SLACK_MAX_FALLBACK_CELL_WIDTH, adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: markdownTableToSlackTableBlock
methods.description: Converts MarkdownTableData into a SlackTableBlock structure.

methods.name: buildSlackTableAttachment
methods.description: Wraps the Slack table block into an attachment object.

methods.name: renderSlackTableFallbackText
methods.description: Generates a plain text fallback representation of the table, respecting length constraints.
